sanjay: onboarding Caldera9b from HF. quick heads-up: int4 conversion + smoke eval shows weird attention spikes and degraded translation quality for accents (é, ñ, ç). anyone seen accent tokenization surprises lately?
emily: ugh that rings a bell. did the converter change tokenizer normalization? we had nfkc vs nfkd flips before.
sanjay: convert command: `python tools/convert_model.py --src caldera9b --out /tmp/caldera-q4 --quant int4 --optimize rotary-shared --tokenizer-normalize auto`
log snip: ```
INFO loading tokenizer.json
WARN tokenizer.normalization=none (card says nfkc)
WARN rotary.config: per_head=true in model, converter wrote shared_scale=true
```
nora: two separate issues: 1) normalization mismatch can merge/separate diacritics -> token boundary changes; 2) switching per-head->shared rotary will misalign kv cache phase per head and show head-specific attention spikes.
emily: what's the perf delta? small smoke bench pls.
sanjay: quick eval (10K tokens):
```
baseline fp16 chr-F: 0.782
int4(shared rotary, normalize=none) chr-F: 0.721
int4(per-head rotary, normalize=preserve_nfd) chr-F: 0.779
```
emily: wow per-head rotary + preserving normalization recovers almost everything. any examples of broken tokenization?
sanjay: example input: "Señor Gómez — dónde está la acción?"
- fp16 tokenization after normalize nfkc: tokens -> [Se, ñ, or,  Gómez,  — ,  dónde, ...]
- converted model (normalize none): tokens -> [Se, ï¿½, nor, Gómez,  — ,  dÃ³nde, ...] (garbled)
nora: that garbling is canonicalization/encoding mismatch. converter's `--tokenizer-normalize auto` fell back to no-op because it couldn't parse HF metadata. we should add a hard-fail when detected normalization metadata != converter setting.
emily: plan: add converter checks: verify `tokenizer.normalization` equals HF card or require explicit `--tokenizer-normalize` flag; honor `rotary.per_head` and error if you ask for shared kernel without opt-in `--force-shared-rotary`. Also add a post-convert `tokenizer_roundtrip` test that samples accent-heavy sentences.
sanjay: opened PR 4201 with the changes + a tiny accent corpus (5k lines) and added `tools/tokenizer_check --roundtrip` to CI. devbot queued bench 9960000005 for PR 4201.
devbot: enqueued bench run 9960000005 for PR 4201, status: queued.
emily: once bench completes run kvcache head-alignment plots across 6 seeds, look for outlier heads (spikes) and diff attention maps between fp16 and int4. if spikes persist maybe there's a head-dimension packing bug in the int4 kernel.
nora: also add a short note to docs/model_onboard.md covering encoding/normalization pitfalls and rotary-per-head vs shared choices, plus a checklist for conversion: `check_hf_card`, `check_tokenizer_roundtrip`, `verify_rotary_flags`, `run_aligner_plot`.
sanjay: thanks both. I'll wait for bench then roll. tagging @eng-ml for visibility.
